notes.title: Battle Mode Demo
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Folks! A demo of Kingdom Wars will be available on April 30th[/h2]

[h3]What to expect[/h3]
[list]
[*] This demo covers the battle mode only (not the campaign).
[*] There will be 4 kings to choose from.
[*] Only 1v1 battle supported.
[*] You can custom your army before the battle.
[/list]
[h3]Differences with the full game[/h3]
[list]
[*] In campaign mode you will build cities, explore for new lands, research technologies, manage diplomacy, train armies and go to war against other kingdoms.
[*] There are 6 playable factions (18 kings to choose from) and one generic non-playable faction
[*] In battle mode you can create up to 3v3 battles.
[/list]
[h3]Join the discord[/h3]
Join the [url=https://discord.gg/E8jhAC6n]Discord server[/url] to give feedback or report bugs.
